acceptanceCriteria: A read (for example plan preview or ticket show) reports tickets whose recent claims allocated a pool member while their record has no requiresPool, without writing anything.
The documented operator guidance in docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md says requiresPool must be set for V1-0786 deferral to apply.
Any inferred requirement is reported as evidence only and never changes selection without an explicit record edit.
body: V1-0786 (CAL resource-aware selection, merged in #574 at 618680492cf8) defers a ticket only when its record declares requiresPool. A ticket that needs a pool member but omits requiresPool is still SELECTED and then fails at claim time, so it still occupies a plan slot that a lane-free ticket could use, which is the #584 starvation shape. Found during the #584 closeout assessment (2026-10-05). Expected: an operator can see which OPEN tickets lack requiresPool while claims for them allocate pool members, or the plan learns the requirement from evidence. Actual: no signal; selection treats them as lane-free.
title: corvint-tasks: resource-aware plan selection does not help tickets that omit requiresPool (issue #584 follow-up)
